item.title: Configuring Portworx for OpenShift Virtualization
item.description: Overview Portworx by Pure Storage provides a highly available, cloud-native storage layer that integrates seamlessly with OpenShift Virtualization. It allows you to provision ReadWriteMany (RWX) and ReadWriteOnce (RWO) volumes for your virtual machines. This guide covers deploying the Portworx Operator and configuring a basic StorageCluster using both the Web Console and CLI.

item.title: Portworx PVC Testing Walkthrough (RWX)
item.description: Overview When using OpenShift Virtualization, Virtual Machine live migrations require shared storage. Portworx provides this via ReadWriteMany (RWX) storage classes. This guide validates that Portworx RWX provisioning works using the px-rwx-vm StorageClass. To prove it’s truly shared storage, we will deploy two pods attached to the same PVC, write data from one pod, and read it from the other.
